issues.legal_issue: The inclusion of land transferred before the statutory cutoff and held as a family member’s separate property in another family member’s agricultural ceiling holding.
material_facts: The ceiling proceedings concerned the appellant’s agricultural landholding and return.
The appellant said that transfers involving land given to his adopted son and land later given by the adopted son to the appellant’s wife took place in 1956.
The Commissioner included the land given to the wife in the appellant’s holding, and the High Court upheld that decision on the ground that the transactions were collusive.
There was no pleading or evidence before the authorities that the transactions were collusive or fraudulent.
The Deputy Collector had excluded the land and determined that only a smaller area was in excess of the ceiling.
issues.conclusion: The land could not be included in the appellant’s ceiling holding. The Court allowed the appeal, set aside the High Court’s and Commissioner’s decisions, and restored the Deputy Collector’s decision.
issues.legal_principle: Under Sections 8, 10 and 12 of the Maharashtra Agricultural Lands (Ceiling of Holdings) Act, 1961, only transfers made on or after 4 August 1959 were affected by the Act; transfers before that cutoff fell outside its operation. Sections 2(11), 2(22) and 6 did not permit a family-unit ceiling assessment to include a member’s separate or self-acquired property merely because of the family relationship. A transfer could not be treated as collusive or fraudulent without a foundation in the pleadings or evidence. The Court relied on no earlier cases.

predicates.land_ceiling_proceeding: The authorities are determining a person’s or family unit’s landholding in an agricultural ceiling proceeding.
predicates.transfer_before_cutoff: The transfer or acquisition of the land being considered occurred before the applicable statutory cutoff.
predicates.separate_member_property: The land was held as a family member’s separate or self-acquired property rather than as shared family property.
predicates.family_unit_assessment: The land was included in another person’s holding on the basis that it belonged to that person’s family unit.

issues.definition: If a ceiling proceeding concerns land transferred before the applicable cutoff, or separately owned property is included in a family-unit assessment, the land is excluded from the ceiling holding.
